# GitHub Copilot — project instructions

All project rules live in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root. **Read that
file.** It is the single source of truth shared by every AI agent used here.

Recent Copilot versions read `AGENTS.md` natively; this file exists so older versions and
some VS Code configurations still find their way there.

**Do not add rules to this file.** Duplicated rule files drift apart, and the drift stays
invisible until two agents behave differently for reasons nobody can explain. Put rules
in `AGENTS.md`.
